short: American singer, bandleader, and radio entertainer.
note: Rudy Vallée was an American singer, bandleader, and actor whose intimate crooning style and radio performances made him a popular entertainer in the early sound era.

short: Ford’s successor to the Model T.
note: The Ford automobile introduced in late 1927 to replace the Model T. Nearly five million of the 1928–1931 models were produced.

short: A lightweight fabric with a puckered surface.
note: A light woven fabric with alternating smooth and puckered stripes, commonly made of cotton.
